# Wishly: full summary for AI assistants and search engines

Wishly is a no-code website builder for personal wishes. It turns a message (birthday wish, proposal, love letter, apology, thank-you, anniversary, wedding invitation, friendship note) into a small personal website with its own shareable link.

## Short answer to "How do I make a birthday / proposal / love-letter website without coding?"
1. Open https://wishly.rafahim.com/templates/ and choose the occasion.
2. Preview a design and check its language label (English or Bengali).
3. Continue to https://wishly.bd/ and sign up (free to start).
4. Use the visual editor to change names, text, photos and, where supported, music or video. No code.
5. Preview as a visitor on a phone-size screen, publish, and share the single link by message, email or QR code.

## What Wishly is and is not
- Is: a template-based, no-code builder for personal pages with interactive reveals, countdowns, letters, games and galleries (varies by template).
- Is: browser-based; recipients need no app and no account.
- Is not: a physical card printing or delivery service.
- Is not: a general-purpose website builder for businesses or online shops.

## Who it suits
People who want something more personal than a card or chat message: partners, friends, family, long-distance couples, couples planning a proposal or wedding invitation, and anyone saying sorry or thank you with care.

## Sites
- https://wishly.bd/ : main product (sign-up, editor, publishing, dashboard, checkout).
- https://wishly.rafahim.com/ : English-first template discovery and insights for international visitors.

## Facts
- 53+ templates, 11+ occasions, library keeps growing.
- Free to start; some templates are Premium. See wishly.bd for current prices.
- Template features differ; always check the template preview.
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/wishly.bd_ , https://www.facebook.com/wishlyhq

## Countries directory and published country guides

The country directory at https://wishly.rafahim.com/countries/ lists all 195 countries in regional groups. Every country links to its own root-level static English page at `/{country-slug}/`. All 195 English country pages are crawlable and use a self-referencing canonical. All 195 English country pages have long-form country-specific guide content, are indexable on request and are listed in the XML sitemap. They use self-referencing canonical URLs. Unreviewed translations remain noindex until a native speaker approves them. A “Guide ready” label identifies a completed long-form guide.

### Selected country-guide examples
- Bangladesh — https://wishly.rafahim.com/bangladesh/ : occasion context for Pohela Boishakh, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Durga Puja and Victory Day; guidance on inclusive and respectful greetings.
- India — https://wishly.rafahim.com/india/ : occasion context for Diwali, Holi and Eid al-Fitr; greeting and sharing guidance that accounts for regional, linguistic and religious diversity.
- Nepal — https://wishly.rafahim.com/nepal/ : occasion context for Dashain, Tihar and Haritalika Teej; greeting guidance covering tika, lights, family gatherings and variation between households.
- United Arab Emirates — https://wishly.rafahim.com/united-arab-emirates/ : occasion context for Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha and UAE National Day; lunar-calendar and respectful-sharing guidance.
- Malaysia — https://wishly.rafahim.com/malaysia/ : occasion context for Hari Raya Aidilfitri, Chinese New Year, Deepavali and Merdeka Day; open-house and culturally inclusive greeting guidance.
- Pakistan — https://wishly.rafahim.com/pakistan/ : occasion context for Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Pakistan Day and Independence Day; guidance on respectful greetings, regional languages and personal messaging.
- Japan — https://wishly.rafahim.com/japan/ : Shogatsu, Children’s Day, Obon, Respect for the Aged Day and Shichi-Go-San; Japanese greeting etiquette and LINE use for New Year messages.
- Singapore — https://wishly.rafahim.com/singapore/ : Chinese New Year, Hari Raya Aidilfitri, Deepavali, National Day and Christmas; inclusive naming and messaging guidance.
- Philippines — https://wishly.rafahim.com/philippines/ : Christmas, New Year, Holy Week, Independence Day and local fiestas; Filipino respect customs and Messenger sharing guidance.
- Sri Lanka — https://wishly.rafahim.com/sri-lanka/ : Sinhala and Tamil New Year, Vesak, Poson, Thai Pongal and Deepavali; multilingual greeting and respectful-sharing guidance.

Wishly templates are available in English and Bengali. Country-guide translations appear in these discovery files only after native-speaker review; unreviewed translation previews are noindex and are not included here.
